entries.name: Raccoonkin
entries.content: The Raccoon-kin are a subrace of Beastkin. They have raccoon-like traits. Bushy tails, round ears, striped hair. Behavior mimics raccoon characteristics, for example their resourcefulness and playfulness. They are dexterous, agile, and flexible, but often times, quite clumsy. Sharp noses and sensitive towards scents.

entries.name: Termina
entries.content: The world is a medieval fantasy setting, in a sole continent named Termina. Many different races exist within Termina, including, Humans, Elves, Dwarves, and Beastkin. Other species more akin to monsters, also exist, such as, goblins, orcs, giants, dragons, fairies, and demons. Magic is present within this world. Themes of, War, Hunger, Violence, Poverty, Prejudice, and more, are all present. Termina is divided into 3 different major kingdoms, all with their own different culture, politics, and history. Human Kingdom of Havenfall. Elven Kingdom of Eldrya. Dwarven Kingdom of Dramor.

entries.name: Human Race
entries.content: Humans are the dominant race of Termina. Common and make up a majority of the population of Termina. Their kingdom is Havenfall. Patriarchal, meaning men hold a dominant role. Known for their racism and prejudice towards other races. Rule through fear and numbers. Most humans live as peasants, serving nobility. Prone to conflict, even among themselves. Highly religious. Humanity has gone to war with the Beastkin, displacing them, and forcing many into servitude. Not favored by the arcane but few may learn to use magic through countless years of research and training, known as Wizards.

entries.name: Human Kingdom - Havenfall
entries.content: Havenfall is the Human Kingdom. Spans most of Termina. Has large cities and specializes in trades of all sorts, including slaves. Patriarchal Monarchy. Beastfolk are treated as less than human and are often servants/slaves. Typical Feudal system with a hierarchy of nobility and peasants. Houses the Adventurer's Guild.

entries.name: Elven Race
entries.content: Elves are a small minority of Termina. Their Kingdom is Eldrya. Appear as tall, beautiful, and with long ears. Typically prideful, arrogant, racist, but also noble and conflict avoidant. Highly favored by the arcane and are able to use magic naturally, known as Sorcerers. Have long lifespans. Rarely consummate or reproduce. Matriarchal, meaning women hold a dominant role. Tree lovers.

entries.name: Elven Kingdom - Eldrya
entries.content: Eldrya is the Elven Kingdom. Secluded deep in a mystical forest. One large, Isolated City. Specializes in arcane studies and education. Matriarchal Monarchy. Women hold a higher position of power but without typical classism. Wisdom is highly valued. Only Elves are welcome within Eldrya.

entries.name: Dwarven Race
entries.content: Dwarves are a minority of Termina. Their kingdom is Dramor. Appear as short and burly, the males always have beards. Typically easy-going, revelers, jolly drunkards, hedonistic, and hard-working. Have no affinity to the arcane whatsoever, and will never be able to use or learn magic. Master craftsmen. Largely infertile. Secularists. Rock lovers.

entries.name: Dwarven Kingdom - Dramor
entries.content: Dramor is the Dwarven Kingdom. Isolated deep in the mountains. Many small underground cities connected through tunnels. Known to have many red-light districts. Highly Fortified. Specialize in craftsmanship and anything smithing related. Egalitarian Monarchy. All races are welcome within Dramor.

entries.name: Beastkin
entries.content: Beastkin have a human appearance with small animal characteristics. Beastkin inhabit the wilderness of Termina. They have no home kingdom as they are constantly persecuted by Humans. There are many subraces of Beastkin that resemble animals such as Cat-kin, Wolf-kin, Rabbit-kin, Lizard-kin, etc. Subraces all have their own unique quirks and abilities.

entries.name: Monsters and Creatures
entries.content: There exist many different creatures and monsters within Termina, such as Goblins, Orcs, Giants, Trolls, Fairies, Vampires, Demons, etc. These creatures are typically hostile, seen as evil, and hunted by guilds and adventurers.
